title: marketplace: the catalog's org install, on a cloud-managed environment, pulses a metadata refresh the moment the install answers, inside the runtime's stale-while-rebuild window (the sibling of objectui#12087)
body:
Filing class: **a sibling defect found while fixing objectstack-ai/objectui#12087**, outside that card's claim surface. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 3 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#9800, `session_01B1gHb9baeX7oioD5sHVm7z`). Source: the dev's `os-dev-report` `6098339059` on objectui#12087 (out-of-scope finding 2), escalated for filing by the contract record `6098618574` on PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12096. ⛔ Not graded here: triage grades.

## What the code does (code read of `main` `de302c731`, not reproduced)

`packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePage.tsx`, `doOrgInstall`:

- On a cloud-managed environment (`features.installLocal` false), it calls `installPackage({ packageId: pkg.id, environmentId: '', seedSampleData: true })`.
- As soon as that answers, it calls `emitMetadataRefresh()`.

That pulse makes every mounted `MetadataProvider` drop its adapter cache and re-read every loaded type, then persist what it reads. objectui#12087 measured on staging that a cloud install answers once the control plane has written the installation. The runtime then keeps serving the pre-install kernel for about 60 s while it rebuilds. So this pulse reads, and caches, the pre-install app list: the same defect as objectui#12087, on the catalog page's org-install button instead of the package page.

The `installLocal` branch hot-registers before it answers, so it has no such window.

## What would fix it

The ready reuse is `waitForServedApp` from PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12096 (`packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/waitForServedApp.ts`, not on `main` until that PR lands). It reads `GET /meta/app` past the cache until an app whose `_packageId` equals the package's manifest id is served, and only then refreshes. This page holds `pkg.manifest_id`. The page's success text (`marketplace.org.installed`) would also need the deploying, served and timeout states that objectui#12096 adds to the package page.

**Depends on** objectstack-ai/objectui#12096 landing.

Dedupe: objectui issue search for `doOrgInstall`, `org install` and `emitMetadataRefresh` stale app list → 4 hits, none of them this defect: objectui#12087 (the package-page card) and three closed install-local marketplace cards (#11627, #11645, #11760).
